nom: DRMTLGY Brightening Eye Masks with Peptides and Hyaluronic Acid

segments.sensitive: One reviewer specifically notes the masks do not irritate her sensitive skin at all, while hydrating and de-puffing the under-eye area.
segments.dry: One reviewer describes her under-eye skin as dry and reports the masks bring intense hydration to that area, likening the effect to a drink of water.
segments.mature: One 67-year-old reviewer reports no crow's feet and hopes continued use will keep firming and brightening the under-eye area over time.

concerns.aging: A large number of reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and crow's or laugh lines with regular use, some over weeks to months; one reviewer notes the smoothing effect from a single mask lasts only a few hours rather than being permanent.
concerns.dehydration: Hydration is one of the most consistently reported effects, with many reviewers across the set describing the under-eye area as noticeably more moisturized and less dry after use; one reviewer, however, said she felt no added hydration or de-puffing benefit at all.
concerns.spots: Dark circles under the eyes are the most frequently discussed concern: many reviewers, including one who says she has struggled with them since childhood, report a visible reduction, with some describing them as almost completely gone after use; a few say the masks help only somewhat, or that it's too early in their use to tell.

aspects.libelle: Patches often slide out of place
Very cooling, especially chilled in the fridge
Jar comes with generous leftover serum
Can feel a little tacky after use

extraits.texte: I wanted to love these eye masks as everyone was raving about them. Thry ate veey wet, difficult to get out and thry do not stick in place. They constantly slide down. Forth price i expected better product and results that lasted. I would not buy again and would tell people to keep shopping for something else.

extraits.titre: I'm in the minority here but I don't love these
extraits.texte: I have used tons of under eye patches from different brands and these fall low on the list of those I enjoy. They tend to slip around and I don't necessarily feel like they leave me with any hydration or depuffing after I've applied them. Just not a fan.

I've struggled with dark circles under my eyes since I was young. I always thought it was a genetic thing, and no matter what I was doomed to look like I've never slept, or having to use under eye concealer for the rest of my life. I put these on, waited the 15 minutes.. and nearly fell over ... I looked normal and I didn't even have to fiddle around trying to make sure the concealer was even, and matched my skin tone. for the first time ever my eyes don't look like I have two black eyes. every product I've purchased from DRMTLGY has been great, but this one is incredible enough for me to write a review and say "don't be too skeptical, these eye masks work!"

I am using my little eye-brightening masks every morning for 15 minutes or so. When I take them off I smooth the remaining serum into my skin around my eyes. They really work! My bags are gone and I feel like I look much more awake (I'm not a morning person, so they help a lot with helping me look less droopy!). I hope over time they will continue to firm and brighten that area under my eyes. I'm 67 and I don't have any crows feet, and these masks help with that too! I really love them!
These Brightening Eye Masks are lightweight and do NOT irritate my sensitive skin at all! Love using them in the morning for 15 minutes and they leave my under eyes hydrated and less puffy.
I ordered extra right after first use because I am so scared it's gone be out of stock! When I take the mask off my wrinkles are gone for few hours, and skin is moisturized and fresh!
These are a drink of water for my dry eyes. The hydration they bring is amazing. I keep them in the frig and they instantly de-puff my tired eyes.
